In [[number theory]], an '''eigencurve''' is a [[Rigid analytic space|rigid analytic curve]] that parametrizes certain [[p-adic number|''p''-adic]] families of [[modular form]]s, and an '''eigenvariety''' is a higher-dimensional generalization of this. Eigencurves were introduced by [[Robert F. Coleman|Coleman]] and [[Barry Mazur|Mazur]],{{sfnp|Coleman|Mazur|1998}} and the term "eigenvariety" seems to have been introduced by [[Kevin Buzzard|Buzzard]].{{sfnp|Buzzard|2007}}
